description:
List the trademarks and trading names that the Spanish patent office (OEPM)
records under a holder with this company's name.

Use it with a slug from search_companies or company_history; to go from a
brand to its company use brand_owner.

Returns JSON {company_slug, commercial_names, trademarks (each {name, file,
status, since}), counts, truncated, limit_per_kind, source, note}: one
entry per OEPM file, so a name can repeat, the company's own name included.
No tax IDs are published: each link is a name match, not confirmed
ownership. An empty list means none is linked in our data, not that the
company holds none; {error, suggested_companies} means an unknown slug:
nothing was looked up. limit applies per kind, newest first; counts is what
this answer lists, not the company's total, and truncated true for a kind
means more are linked: raise limit.

Read-only; one request per call. Needs the basic plan or higher: send your
API key in the X-API-Key header (https://bormeapi.com/account).

company.description: Company slug, as returned by search_companies or company_history, e.g. vaz-metales-sl.
company.title: Company

limit.description: Maximum results per kind (trademarks, trading names), integer 1-200, e.g. 10 (default 50).
limit.title: Limit
